content.text: Regular waking at 8 does happen, and it's often tied to worries, a busy head, or screens late in the evening. Tonight, try 10 minutes of quiet talk before lights out. Ask what's on her mind, and let her park any worries on paper by the bed. If she wakes at 2, keep it calm and boring and walk her straight back to bed. If it keeps up or she seems really distressed, mention it to your doctor.
